_comment: Every pkg-config module a Flutter plugin demands with `pkg_check_modules(... REQUIRED ...)` on Linux, and the packages that satisfy it — at build time (apt, on the machines that run `flutter build linux`) and at run time (the .deb/PKGBUILD dependency lists). `tool/check_linux_pkgconfig.dart` (in `make check`) reads this file, re-derives the demands from the resolved plugin sources, and fails when the two disagree in either direction. THIS EXISTS BECAUSE v0.4.9 HAD NO RELEASE. The nativeapi migration (#1741) brought in cnativeapi, which requires `ayatana-appindicator3-0.1` — the one of its four modules that `libgtk-3-dev` does not pull in. Nothing built the Linux desktop between that merge and the tag, so the first machine to notice was the release chain: `flutter build linux` died in CMake before compiling a single file, the `linux` job failed, `publiceren` needs it, and no release appeared. A missing build dep is invisible to every gate that only runs `flutter test`. NOTE THE CEILING: this gate sees pkg-config demands, which is how Flutter's Linux plugins ask for system libraries — it does NOT see `find_library`, `find_package`, a header a plugin includes directly, or a command a build script shells out to. Those still surface only in a real build, which is what the post-merge Linux build in .forgejo/workflows/linux-build.yml is for. Two layers, deliberately: this one names the fix in the PR that causes it, that one catches what static reading cannot.

modules.why: The Flutter Linux shell itself, plus cnativeapi's window and tray code.
Demanded by the Flutter Linux runner template alongside gtk+-3.0; libgtk-3-dev depends on it.
Same package as glib-2.0, same route: libgtk-3-dev brings it.
Required by cnativeapi, but installed as a dependency of libgtk-3-dev — gtk+-3.0.pc requires x11 transitively, so a build environment that has GTK has this.
Same as x11: cnativeapi asks for it, libgtk-3-dev brings it.
flutter_secure_storage_linux keeps the storage credentials in the session keyring.
cnativeapi's tray icon (#1741). The module libgtk-3-dev does NOT pull in — the one that broke the v0.4.9 release.
